Final for Publication

Type 1 Zoning
Narrative for
537-547 West Oak Street, 939-957 North Larrabee Street
DR-3 to DR-3

A. The applicant proposes to rezone the subject property from DR-3 Downtown
Residential District to DR-3 Downtown Residential District. The subject property is
currently unimproved. The purpose ofthe amendment to permit the development of a 78-
unit, 7-story residential building. The subject property is a Transit Serviced Location
based on proximity to the Chicago Avenue 66 Bus line.

The applicant is seeking all zoning relief as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
code, including the following relief:

(i) a reduction in minimum lot area per dwelling unit for Transit-Served Locations
meeting 100% of the ARO requirement on-site as permitted in accordance with Section
17-4-0404-C;

(ii) an increase in the maximum FAR for Transit-Served Locations meeting 100% of the
ARO requirement on site in accordance with Section 17-4-0405-C;

(iii) as per Type I Section 17-13-0303-D, a reduction in the rear yard from 38.20 feet to
23 feet 3-3/8 inches in accordance with Section 17-13-1101-B;

(iv) parking relief for a Transit-Served Locations in accordance with 17-10-0102-B;

(v) areduction in the percentage of EVSE-ready spaces or EVSE-installed spaces required
by Section 17-10-1011-A(2) to the applicable value for “affordable housing” as defined
in the Illinois Electric Vehicle Charging Act in accordance with Section 17-13-1101-A
and 17-13-1003-LL.

B. Lot Area 25,240 square feet
C. Total Floor Area 97,377 square feet
D, FAR 4.0

E. Number of Dwelling Units 78 dwelling units

F. Density (Lot area per dwelling unit) 320 square feet

G. Building Height Not to exceed 80’0”
